release: Occupational Outlook Handbook, last modified August 27, 2026
wageUnit: USD median annual wage, national, all experience levels
transformation: Transcribed individual-occupation median annual wages from the Pay paragraphs. Growth is included only for pages with a single occupation, not the grouped software/developer/tester summary. No inflation adjustment, annualization or aggregation.
limitations: Broad occupations are contextual proxies, not AI-title salary estimates, starting pay, local wages or hiring guarantees. Editorial role mappings are approximate; some roles have multiple possible occupations.

occupations.name: Software developers
occupations.mapping: AI application, LLM and automation engineering: related software work; model-specific responsibilities are a subset.

occupations.name: Software quality assurance analysts and testers
occupations.mapping: Testing and evaluation: useful testing context; model evaluation and research may map differently.

occupations.name: Information security analysts
occupations.mapping: Security and responsible-AI controls: related security work; not every governance or AI-security engineer is in this occupation.

occupations.name: Computer network architects
occupations.mapping: AI infrastructure networking: related network design; junior operations and sales engineering differ.

occupations.name: Data scientists
occupations.mapping: Data/model work: related statistical and analytical tasks; data engineering and platform work can map elsewhere.
